plan.summary: This first 4-week block sets a simple off-camp foundation for boxing with one weekly S&C session. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main lower-body lift so percentage work can start cleanly, and the main program begins in Week 2. With only one gym day and a preference for a bit more conditioning, each session keeps power first, then strength, then practical accessories and short conditioning without adding excess soreness that interferes with boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic lower-body power, squat strength, trunk strength, and simple work capacity with beginner-friendly exercises.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts steadily while keeping the session compact and recoverable around boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and shift more emphasis toward faster, sharper power output without forcing a fight-camp peak.
